title: 17-year-old turns her love of photography into a cancer fundraiser
summary_full: For over a year, a Brooklyn teenager showcased the allure of Prospect Park in her photographs. The passion project transformed into a community print sale aimed at supporting cancer research for Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center. Inspired by her father’s battle with cancer, she cleverly merged creativity and community spirit to make a difference in the fight against the disease.
